title: 2484. Count Palindromic Subsequences

examples.explanation: There are 6 possible subsequences of length 5: "10330","10331","10301","10301","13301","03301". Two of them (both equal to "10301") are palindromic.
All 21 subsequences are "00000", which is palindromic.
The only two palindromic subsequences are "99999" and "00000".
